arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Test Result slice access
r = parse.parse('{:d} {:d} {:d}', '1 2 3')
print('Full result:', r.fixed)

# Slice access
r_slice = r[0:2]
print('Slice [0:2]:', r_slice.fixed, type(r_slice))

# Another slice
r_slice2 = r[1:]
print('Slice [1:]:', r_slice2.fixed, type(r_slice2))

# Negative indices
r_slice3 = r[-2:]
print('Slice [-2:]:', r_slice3.fixed, type(r_slice3))

# Named results should still work
r_named = parse.parse('{a:d} {b:d} {c:d}', '1 2 3')
print('Named fixed:', r_named.fixed)
print('Named a:', r_named['a'])
"
